enchantments.tooltip: Heightened Awareness 6: This item helps you to quickly read situations with sharpness and clarity, allowing you to predict actions before they occur. You gain a +6 Insight bonus to AC.
Listen +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Listen skill.
Reflex Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.

Proof Against Disease +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
Summon Legendary Werewolf: This item can call to a Werewolf to fight for you for a brief time.(On its own, this enchantment has no effect.)
Legendary Windlasher's Ferocity: 2 Pieces Equipped:+15% Artifact bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot+15 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power
